Index.hero_title: Take Control of Your Finances with AI
Index.hero_subtitle: Stop typing your expenses manually. Just snap a photo of your receipt, and our AI will extract, categorize, and track it instantly.
Index.features_title: Everything you need to manage your money
Index.feature_1_desc: Upload any receipt and our AI extracts the merchant, date, and total amount instantly.
Index.feature_2_desc: Expenses are automatically categorized so you always know exactly where your money goes.
Index.feature_3_desc: Beautiful charts and reports help you understand your spending habits at a glance.
